verdict.rationale: Groq's docs show that nearly all model-serving functionality (chat, streaming, tool use/function calling, structured outputs, batch, service tiers, LoRA, Responses API, remote MCP) is exposed via the API and mirrors what the console UI offers, and the API is even the primary interface (OpenAI-compatible). However, account-management features like spend limits, billing alerts, and rate-limit visibility are described as configured/viewed 'in your account settings' (console UI) with no documented API endpoints for setting or reading them, and no public OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe-3 all 404), so full programmatic parity with the console cannot be confirmed. missing for 10: API endpoints for spend-limit/billing configuration, a published OpenAPI schema proving full UI-API parity, and independent confirmation of console-only features being API-accessible.
